title: Natalie Brock's quarter-acre flower farm now pays the family's bills

posts.facebook:
Natalie Brock left teaching at 51 to grow flowers on a neglected quarter-acre. It now pays the family's bills.

Natalie Brock, a former teacher and school wellbeing leader in the South Australian Riverland, turned a quarter-acre of neglected land into the Coco and Honey flower farm at 51. What began as a sideline became the family's main income after frost hit the region's vineyards.

If you have ten working years left, spend them on something you actually love — and start it small, alongside the day job.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/earn/natalie-brock-flower-farm-at-51/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
